introHtml: Hand wash only electronics are built for environments where gentle care extends product life, such as commercial kitchens, labs, or food service areas. Unlike standard electronics that can withstand automatic dishwashers, these items require manual cleaning to preserve sensitive components and custom imprints. Choose from custom-printed timers, Bluetooth speakers, or small appliances that maintain their branded appearance with simple soap-and-water care. Perfect for safety managers equipping break rooms or HR directors distributing practical branded gifts that stay clean without harsh cycles.
